support.title: Support Natively
support.body: Natively is built and maintained by one developer. If it's part of your daily workflow, your support keeps it moving forward.

about.title: About Natively
about.tagline: Designed to be invisible, intelligent, and trusted.
about.zhBuildNotice: This is a community Simplified Chinese build. It never downloads or installs official updates automatically. Installing an official release will replace this build and remove the Chinese interface.

news.uiStylesBody: Introduced two gorgeous, immersive interface themes, Liquid Glass and Modern Dark, to completely redefine your real-time overlay experience.
news.deepseekBody: Full support for DeepSeek's advanced reasoning models, delivering ultra-smart and cost-effective chat replies.
news.audioBody: Hardened macOS system audio process tapping and security permission gates to guarantee robust capture streams.
news.modesBody: The Profile Intelligence matrix and Modes Manager have been optimized like crazy for responsive, ultra-low latency context processing.
news.updatesBody: Enjoy seamless, single-click updates directly inside the desktop app with zero manual installation loops.

how.hybridBody: Seamlessly routes queries between ultra-fast models for instant speed and reasoning models (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude) for complex tasks. Powered by enterprise-grade speech recognition from 7+ providers.

privacy.stealthBody: Features "Undetectable Mode" to hide from the dock and "Masquerading" to disguise as system apps. You control exactly what data leaves your device.
privacy.noRecordingBody: Natively listens only when active. It does not record video, take arbitrary screenshots without command, or perform background surveillance.

about.creatorQuote1: I build software that stays out of the way.
about.creatorQuote2: <0></0> is made to feel fast, quiet, and respectful of your privacy.

support.starBody: Love Natively? Support us by starring the repo.
support.issueBody: Found a bug? Let us know so we can fix it.
support.contactBody: Open for professional collaborations and job offers.
